reason: 'Perianth segments free' means the tepals are not fused to each other. Tepal + attachment quality + free (FLOPO_0991068) says exactly that.
'Style greatly exceeding the stamens' is a length comparison: the style is longer than the stamens. 'Greatly' gives no ratio, so leaving it out is fine.
Rhizome creeping: FLOPO_0991009 creeping (a kind of prostrate) lists rhizome among its intended bearers.
The involucral bracts are yellow-white or yellow-brown. Bract is a fair, more general bearer, and both alternatives are kept.

fix: Pattern 'Lower X ..., the upper Y': 'the upper' starts a new statement about the upper members of X. The upper/lower position must go into the position slot; dropping it merges two contrasting statements.
reason: The flora contrasts the lower bracts (longer than the ovary) with the upper ones (about equal to it). Without 'upper', 'bracts about equal the ovary' is false for the lower bracts.
Lateral veins 8-11 on each side of the blade: the count, the bearer, the leaf lamina container and the each-side position all match.
The cymules (small sub-units of the inflorescence) are several-flowered. 'Several flowers present, contained in the inflorescence' is true, though less specific than the cymule.
'Thorns & Spines: Absent' says thorns are absent. Spines are absent too, but the thorn annotation is not wrong.

'Seeds brown, narrowly elliptic': the seed is elliptic. The same words also describe the pleurogram (a horseshoe-shaped mark on the seed face), but the annotation is true of the seed either way. Only 'narrowly' is lost.
The aerial flowering stems are (0.3-)0.5-0.7 dm. Converted, that is 5-7 cm with a lower extreme of 3 cm, which is correct. Height of the stem is a fair reading.
'Leaf blade abaxially sparsely pubescent': moving the bearer to the leaf lamina abaxial epidermis (the lower surface of the blade) is right. Only 'sparsely' is lost.
Corolla white or yellowish green: both alternatives are kept.

target: capsule teeth (the teeth at the mouth of the dehiscent fruit; no exact PO class, so annotate as fruit with a part slot for the teeth or as a new bearer candidate)
fix: Pattern 'Capsules ...; teeth N, Q1 or Q2': after the semicolon, the qualities belong to the teeth named first in that clause, not to the capsule.
reason: It is the capsule's 10 teeth that are erect or partially spreading. The capsule itself is described as ca. straight. Also 'partially' is dropped.

fix: Check whether 'crêtes' on orchid pseudobulbs means ridges, which would be 'costate' (ribbed) rather than 'crested'.
reason: 'Pseudobulbes ... dépourvus de crêtes' means the pseudobulbs lack crêtes, and the negation scope is right. But on Bulbophyllum pseudobulbs crêtes are probably the longitudinal ridges, so 'crested' (an irregular or toothed ridge) may be the wrong quality.

fix: Read 'stemless' as acaulescent (no visible stem above ground). 'Stem absent' is the usual approximation.
reason: 'Annual stemless herb' means there is no stem above ground. Plantago has only a very short basal axis, so 'stem absent' is a fair reading.
Fruit blue-black when mature: the 'mature' state slot is filled.
Upper glume 1-3-veined: 1-3 veins (vascular bundles) in the glume. 'Upper' is not kept, but the lower glume is 1(-3)-veined too, so the statement is still true.
Sepals with gland-pits on the inner (adaxial) side fits gland-dotted. The adaxial place is lost, but the statement stays true.
The perianth segments are yellowish: tepal, yellow, marked 'approximately'.
Bracteoles green to blue, read as a range between the two colours.
(1-)1.5-3.5(-5) dm converts to 15-35 cm, with extremes 10 and 50 cm. Correct.
Filaments shorter than the anthers.
'Bulbs ovoid, 2–4 cm': a single size for an ovoid bulb is its length.
The calycular bracts (the small outer bracts below the phyllaries) are shorter than the achenes. Bract is a fair, more general bearer.

fix: In orchid descriptions, 'dorsal' and 'lateral' sepals should fill the position slot when the flora gives them.
reason: The lateral sepals are ± broadly oblong. 'Lateral' is lost, but the dorsal sepal is elliptic-oblong, so 'sepals ± oblong' stays roughly true.
Lamina subcoriaceous to chartaceous, read as a texture range.
Ovary sparsely pubescent at the base when young: the 'young' state slot is filled. 'At base' is lost, but the statement stays true.
'Leaves: basal ... tapering to winged petioles': the basal leaves taper. The 'basal' slot is filled, and leaf is a fair bearer.
Rhizome more than 3 mm in diameter: lower bound 3 mm, no upper bound.
Leaf lobes 0-4 per side: the count, the leaf lamina container and the each-side position are right.
